title: Tiny, cute television
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- antenna -->
  <line x1='42' y1='22' x2='34' y2='10' stroke='#9be7ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='9' r='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='22' x2='66' y2='10' stroke='#9be7ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='9' r='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- tv body -->
  <rect x='14' y='22' width='72' height='56' rx='10' fill='#7ec8e3'/>
  <rect x='16' y='24' width='68' height='52' rx='9' fill='#59b8d6'/>
  <!-- screen bezel -->
  <rect x='22' y='30' width='46' height='32' rx='5' fill='#1e3a5f'/>
  <!-- screen glow -->
  <rect x='25' y='33' width='40' height='26' rx='4' fill='#bdefff'/>
  <!-- cute eyes on screen -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='44' rx='4.5' ry='5' fill='#1e3a5f'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='44' rx='4.5' ry='5' fill='#1e3a5f'/>
  <circle cx='37.5' cy='42' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='55.5' cy='42' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile on screen -->
  <path d='M38 51 Q45 56 52 51' stroke='#1e3a5f' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='50' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#ff9aa2'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='50' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#ff9aa2'/>
  <!-- control panel -->
  <circle cx='75' cy='40' r='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <rect x='71' y='56' width='8' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#c9eefc'/>
  <rect x='71' y='60' width='8' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#c9eefc'/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <rect x='24' y='78' width='12' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <rect x='64' y='78' width='12' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
</svg>
